ACTION6.effect: Acts on the clicked cell, addressed by self.action.data['x'] and ['y']. gwfodrkvzx at :4267 converts the click through the camera offset and branches on what sprite occupies the cell; the bridge-edit path is the common one in play (640 of the 1,024 actions in the human win).

branch_conditions.meaning: clicked cell holds a bridge-buildable sprite: runs the build animation.

ACTION7.effect: Pops the undo stack. This is the ONE branch of the match that does not first call vlyikbzinq() - compare :4496, :4501, :4506, :4511, :4516 and :4521. yodvybvftxa.svmaaixutx at :1455 delegates to waummvnxwvp.svmaaixutx at :441, which returns [] when the stack is empty.
ACTION7.note: On a board already flipped to GAME_OVER the engine returns data.frame: [] and the session API does not count the row. Observed on rows 215, 370, 390, 572 and 807 of c935ca1b-dfee-4be1-9574-bf4cc80c5b89.

RESET.effect: Clears the undo stack and restores the level-start snapshot. yodvybvftxa.eubgwokpez at :1460 delegates to waummvnxwvp.eubgwokpez at :447. The snapshot it restores is the one taken by jpexoivelf() - Bp35.on_set_level calls it at :4540, which delegates from :1446 to :327.
RESET.note: RESET is engine-level and is never listed in available_actions, but is always accepted.

unhandled_actions.note: Every GameAction has a branch in this match. Three of them (ACTION1, ACTION2, ACTION5) are unreachable through the API.

sibling_builds.reason: bp35-0a0ad940 is the only bp35 build in either manifest and the only bp35 directory under docs/static/games/src/. The question does not arise. See dispatch/README.md for the cross-game measurement that settles it in general.

notes: ACTION1, ACTION2 and ACTION3 are all a single LEFT step; only ACTION4 goes right. Verified by reading oreuzgjmdx at :4055 to its end - dy is dead, and `pass` at :4062 is the last statement.

GRAPH_BUILDER is False at module scope (:4443) and set True only inside _get_valid_actions (:4549), so during real play every ACTION1-6 branch does push an undo snapshot; the guard only suppresses it during the valid-action probe.
bp35 is one of only two games in this scope that handles ACTION7 and RESET in its own source. Everywhere else those are handled by `arcengine`, which is not vendored in this repo.
